description: This PHP class, EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel, is part of the OrangeHRM project. It models the allowed languages for an employee, including methods to convert the model into an array suitable for serialization or API responses. The class interacts with external services and entities related to employee languages and fluencies.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class representing the allowed languages for an employee, including language details and allowed fluency IDs, with the ability to serialize to an array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with employee number and languages.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazy initialization of the EmployeeLanguageService instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Transforms the model into an array structure, including logic to determine allowed fluency IDs based on existing employee language entries.
